audit_scope: Selected public main files and open PR metadata; prior conversations only partial retrieval, not a complete chat export or private-repository inventory
principles: Component version != program version != experimental support
A documented terminology spec v0.1 does not assign independent v0.1 to all five axes
A proposed PR version must not be presented as released on main
No result promotion from documentation, citation counts or CI success
Never replace an original version or negative result; record source, scope, falsifier and diff
UNASSIGNED means no verified separate release/version, not version zero
